rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a genotype x treatment interaction, fits a single DESeq2 NB model with ~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment, sets explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle), tests the named interaction coefficient, and builds both simple effects (the KO effect via a combined-coefficient contrast list), which is exactly the reference approach; it also flags the low power of a difference-of-differences at n=4/cell rather than reading a null interaction as no difference. QC (blind VST PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes, flag-not-drop outlier policy), a minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group size), in-model median-of-ratios normalization with an explicit ban on pre-normalized input, per-contrast BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, p-value histograms, and ashr shrinkage reported alongside unshrunken LFC/SE are all specified. Enrichment is the weakest element: ORA with the tested-gene universe and rrvgo collapse is defensible and the universe is explicit, but no gene-set size window is given, the collection version is only loosely pinned (GO via org.Hs.eg.db rather than a versioned collection), a ranked GSEA on the full list with a stated metric is dismissed on shaky grounds, and human annotation is assumed without justification. Reporting is thorough: design, reference levels, versions, thresholds, tested/significant counts, diagnostics, and an explicit limitations section.
